module: State node "State Exit" (created by _flowgraph_createStateNode). Exit point of the state graph: an input pin 'flow' of type state (manual pins of type state allowed), hidden in the menus. The transitionName field designates the transition (output pin of the parent state node) to take; chosen in the editor among those of the target node.
notes: The "(None)" choice sets transitionName to nil whereas the initial value is ''; drawMiddle displays "No Transition!" for nil.

C.desc: Flowgraph node class (returned by _flowgraph_createNode(C)). The methods are called by the flowgraph manager or the editor.

drawCustomProperties.desc: "Transition Name" dropdown built from the transition names of the parent state node that targets this graph.

drawMiddle.desc: Draws the central content of the node in the editor.
